contributions.statement: If a hook injects a repository map into agent context, refresh it only when the agent's exploration focus shifts; refreshing after every model call dropped resolve rate 63.1% -> 51.0% and maximised tokens, while never refreshing cost 4.7 points.
contributions.evidence: Table 3 ablation (Qwen only, single run): per-call refresh 51.0%, no refresh -4.7, full 63.1; textual source-location index removal -3.9 vs image removal -1.9.
relative_to: P07 code-graph context; P08 context management

contributions.statement: Do not rely on a static code graph to localise behaviour wired at runtime (registries, DI, reflection); in that case the gold file was never opened.
contributions.evidence: §5.4 failure case sympy-17630: runtime-registered dependency absent from graph; gold file unopened in 8 runs.

reason: The headline gain is within noise, but the refresh-frequency ablation is a large, mechanism-bearing effect usable by anyone building context-injection hooks; the runtime-dependency limit is known and matters for Spring.
